screens.name: User Administration
screens.purpose: Single-page admin console to create ERIS accounts, edit each account's application roles inline, reset passwords, and enable/disable sign-in access.
roles: ADMIN only. Route is wrapped in RoleRoute roles={["ADMIN"]} (web/src/App.tsx:143-150); sidebar entry 'Administration > Users' is pushed only when isAdmin(roles) (web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:93-101). Non-admins hitting the URL are redirected to /submissions (web/src/auth/RoleRoute.tsx:18-19); unauthenticated users go to /login (RoleRoute.tsx:15-16).
primaryTasks: Create a new account with an initial password and one or more roles
Find a user and change their roles (Save roles)
Reset a user's password or disable/enable their access

responsive.layout: Single vertical stack inside AppShell (non-workspace mode): count-card grid, header card, optional inline create form, filter row, banners, full-width table. Below lg the sidebar becomes a nav card stacked ABOVE the content (AppShell.tsx:164), at lg+ a 256px/64px sticky sidebar (AppShell.tsx:165).
breakpointsUsed: flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between; self-start md:self-auto (:185-187)
flex-1 overflow-auto container around a w-full table with no min-w (:212-213)
AppShell: lg:hidden stacked nav / hidden lg:block sidebar w-64|w-16; header name hidden md:block; theme select hidden sm:flex (AppShell.tsx:146,157,164-165)
phoneRisks: Stacked navigation card (AppShell.tsx:164) renders the full section list above the page content on every visit, so the count cards and table start roughly one screen down.

Table is w-full with 4 columns and no min-width (:213): on ~280px of usable width the Roles chip cloud collapses to one chip per line, giving each row 6+ lines of chips; long emails in text-xs cannot wrap (:221) so the whole table scrolls horizontally inside overflow-auto (:212).

The three row buttons (Save roles / Reset password / Disable) wrap into a vertical stack via inline-flex flex-wrap (:224); each is ~28px tall (py-1.5 text-xs) and role chips ~24px (py-1 text-[11px], :244) - below the 44px touch guideline.
Create form stacks to one column (fine) but exposes two Cancel buttons plus the header toggle (:187, :192, :199).
No hover fallback for chip title tooltips (:244) - purely cosmetic loss.
tabletRisks: 768-1023px is still below lg, so the nav card stays stacked above content (AppShell.tsx:164) - portrait iPads pay the same scroll cost as phones.
Table gets ~650-900px: chip cloud wraps to 2-3 lines per row; action buttons wrap to two lines; no column is hidden or collapsed.
md:grid-cols-3 create form (:193) yields ~200px inputs at 768px - usable but tight for emails.
desktopNotes: At lg+ the 4 count cards sit in one row; table fills the remaining width with chips capped at max-w-3xl (:240).
Entire user list renders in one table with no pagination or column sorting (:69-80, :216); filtering is client-side only.

painPoints.issue: Unsaved role edits on any row are silently discarded whenever load() runs - i.e. after saving roles for a different user, toggling Disable/Enable, creating an account, or pressing Refresh - because draftRoles is rebuilt from the server response.
painPoints.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:49 (draftRoles reset in load), :113, :136, :151 (load() after every mutation), :206 (Refresh)

painPoints.issue: Disable is a single click with no confirmation and no client-side guard against disabling your own account or the last administrator.

Every row renders the full role-option chip set as inline editors, so the table is tall and, on phones and tablets, becomes a wall of chips with the actions pushed off to the right; role editing should be progressively disclosed.
One global busy flag disables every button on the page (all rows, Refresh, Create) during any single request, and 'Refreshing…' appears while, e.g., a password reset is in flight.
Search input and status select have no accessible name (placeholder only); tables have no caption; banners are not live regions so screen readers are not told a save succeeded or failed.
Role chips hide the checkbox with sr-only and give the label no focus-visible style, so keyboard users get no visible focus indicator while tabbing through 6+ chips per row.
Three redundant ways to dismiss the create form (header toggle, top Cancel, bottom Cancel).
No <form> element: pressing Enter in the create fields or search does nothing; no password policy hint on 'Initial password'.
Success/error feedback renders above the table, far from the row that was acted on in a long list; notices never auto-dismiss.
Count cards are static and not clickable as filters; no sort or pagination for the table.
Internal 'User #id' printed on every row.

The chip set is whatever /admin/roles returns; the role model carries legacy aliases (MAINTENANCE, MAINT_COORDINATOR, OFFICE_CHIEF, BRANCH_CHIEF, FIELD_WORKER), so if the backend lists them the admin sees near-duplicate chips like 'Office Chief' and 'Geotech Office Chief' with no explanation. Not verifiable from the frontend.

strengths: Dirty-checking: 'Save roles' is disabled until the draft differs from the saved roles, preventing no-op saves (:218, :224).
Client-side guardrails with clear copy: at least one role required for new and existing accounts (:101-103, :123-125); required-field message names the fields (:97-99).
Success notices name the affected user ('Updated roles for Jane Doe.') (:111, :135, :150, :165).
Combined search over name, email, role and id with instant client-side filtering plus a status filter (:69-80).
Create form is inline and collapsible rather than a modal; uses autoComplete='off'/'new-password' correctly (:194-196).
Role codes are humanized via roleLabel (:8-10); status badge uses color plus text (:12-18).
Consistent theme tokens (--line/--panel/--brand/--good/--bad) so light/dark/coastal themes work without page-specific colors.

Generate/regenerate and download the mobile package after a change

tabletRisks: Below 1024px the nav card is stacked above content (AppShell.tsx:164) and the authoritative section stays stacked (lg:flex-row only, :147): the package card drops under the metrics and stretches full width while retaining min-w-72.

No sorting on the versions table; order is whatever the API returns (:193).

painPoints.issue: Page order runs against the workflow: import lives in the middle, the resulting pending version and its Publish button are below it, and the package Generate/Regenerate control the dialog tells you to use next is at the top - so the import -> publish -> regenerate sequence reads bottom-to-top with a long scroll between each step.
painPoints.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:146-179 (package card), :181 (import panel), :183-202 (versions); RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:67 ('After this change, regenerate the mobile ... package')

painPoints.issue: On phones the Publish/Rollback buttons are the 9th column of a horizontally scrolling table with no scroll affordance, hiding the page's primary actions.
Package card fixed min-w-72 overflows the 375px content width and gets clipped on 360px devices.

Version, segment count, package readiness and generated date are each shown twice (summary cards vs authoritative section/package card) with divergent wording ('Not ready' vs 'Not generated', 'Segments' vs 'Rows').
SHA-256 is truncated to 16 characters with no copy button, so it cannot serve its verification purpose.
Internal ids exposed: '#id' first column, 'Authoritative' text duplicating the 'Published' badge in the same row.
Success/error banners for publish, rollback and package generation render near the top of a ~5-screen page, away from the control that triggered them; no aria-live.
Truncated filenames and card values reveal their full text only via hover title - unavailable on touch.
Horizontal scroll containers are not keyboard-focusable (no tabIndex), so keyboard-only users cannot reach the Actions column when it overflows.
Three heading-like lines stacked at the top (h1 'Road Inventory', eyebrow 'Authoritative roadway reference', h2 'Road inventory operations').
Generate/Regenerate package has no confirmation even though regeneration replaces the artifact field devices download; 'Download package' opens a new tab with no indicator.

strengths: Authoritative-state changes are explicit and confirmed through a dialog that names both the target and the version being superseded (RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:53-65).
Action buttons are rendered only when valid for the row status (Publish for pending, Rollback for superseded), and the published row is tinted (:194-196).
Summary cards carry tone: package readiness turns warn/red when the field package is missing, with a plain-language consequence sentence (:138, :174).
Empty states everywhere explain the next step ('Import a dataset and explicitly publish the version ERIS should use.') (:151, :189).
Notices are specific ('Published road inventory version 2026-08-17.') (:86, :104, :107).
Manifest fetch failure is handled separately from version-list failure, so a missing manifest shows an empty state rather than an error (:57-63).
Locale-aware dates and thousands separators (formatDate, toLocaleString) (:17-22, :137).

One error state is shared by 'load history' and 'submit import', so a history-load failure can be mistaken for an upload failure and vice versa.
Version-tag format guidance lives only in the placeholder, which disappears on typing.
History exposes truncated UUIDs and bare dataset ids instead of version tags; hover-only titles for full values.
No <form>; Enter in the version tag field does nothing.

strengths: Clear expectation-setting copy that imports stay pending until explicitly published (:115).
Start import is disabled until a file is chosen; the selected file name and size are echoed back (:142, :147).
Accept filter restricts the picker to .xlsx (:128); the file input and tag are cleared after submit (:97-99).
Polling stops on terminal states, refreshes history and notifies the parent so the versions table updates without a manual refresh (:77-82).
Poll interval is cleared on unmount (:66-68).
Success summary states rows imported and skipped in one sentence (:154).

screens.name: Verify Authoritative Lookup panel
screens.purpose: Lets an admin test how the published road inventory resolves a county/route/post-mile before field workflows rely on it.
primaryTasks: Enter county, route, post mile (and optional district) and confirm a segment resolves

dataShown.label: Heading 'Verify authoritative lookup' + explanatory sentence
dataShown.note: Explains why the tool exists.

dataShown.label: Inputs: County code (placeholder SAC, maxLength 8), Route (50), Post mile (number, step 0.001), District (Optional, maxLength 4)
dataShown.note: Placeholders double as format examples; labels are real <label>s via Field.

dataShown.label: Validation error 'County, route, and a numeric post mile are required.'
dataShown.note: But an empty post mile passes (see pain points).

dataShown.label: No-match message 'No matching road segments were returned by the published dataset.'
dataShown.note: Primary negative outcome.

dataShown.label: Results columns District, County, Route(+suffix), Begin PM, End PM
dataShown.note: Confirm the match and its PM range - the verification outcome.

dataShown.label: Results column 'PM Prefix'
dataShown.note: Raw code (e.g. R/M); matters for PM disambiguation.

dataShown.label: Results columns Length mi, Left/Right Lanes, Left/Right Surface, Median, Median W, Terrain, Speed, ADT, Landmark (12 columns)
dataShown.note: Raw inventory attribute codes; useful occasionally, candidate for an expandable detail row.

dataShown.label: Busy label 'Looking up…'
dataShown.note: Only progress cue.

actions.label: Run lookup (primary)
actions.where: Fifth grid cell: full-width on phone, half-width orphan cell at sm-lg, inline at lg+

entryPoints: Scroll to the bottom of /admin/road-inventory (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:204); no anchor, tab, or link from elsewhere
exits: None; results stay in local state and are lost on refresh

responsive.layout: Card with a 5-cell form grid and a 17-column results table in overflow-x-auto.
breakpointsUsed: overflow-x-auto results wrapper; whitespace-nowrap headers; text-xs; max-w-52 truncate on Landmark (:51-54)
phoneRisks: Results table has 17 columns with nowrap headers (:53) - several screens of horizontal scroll to reach Landmark; the essential columns are first, which mitigates it.
No scroll affordance on the overflow container; Landmark full text only on hover title (:54).
Form stacks to one column (fine); inputs 36px tall.
tabletRisks: sm-lg: 2-column grid puts the 'Run lookup' button alone in a third row, stretched to half width and not aligned with any input (:39).
desktopNotes: Form is one row at lg; the 17-column text-xs table still needs horizontal scroll below roughly 1500px of content width.

painPoints.issue: Validation bug: Number('') is 0 and Number.isFinite(0) is true, so leaving Post mile empty passes validation and silently queries PM 0.000 even though the error copy says a numeric post mile is required.
Seventeen raw-coded columns for a 'does it resolve' check; no progressive disclosure of the 12 attribute columns and no human labels for codes like surface/terrain/PM prefix.
Button orphaned in its own row between sm and lg.
No <form>/Enter submit; no aria-live on error or no-match message; overflow container not keyboard-focusable.
Tool is buried at the bottom of a ~5-screen admin page though it is the only place to sanity-check a published dataset.

strengths: Explicit no-match empty state distinct from errors (:48).
County code is normalized to upper case client-side (:24); post mile uses a numeric input with 0.001 step (:42).
Essential columns (District, County, Route, PMs) are ordered first (:53).
Placeholders give concrete Caltrans examples (SAC, 50, 12.5) (:40-42).

screens.name: Publish / Rollback Confirmation Dialog
screens.purpose: Confirms an authoritative-state change by restating the target version, what will be superseded, and the follow-up package regeneration.
roles: ADMIN (only reachable from Road Inventory Workspace, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:207)
primaryTasks: Confirm or cancel publishing a pending version or rolling back to a superseded one

dataShown.label: Eyebrow 'Authoritative dataset change'
dataShown.note: Category label; acceptable but could be dropped.

dataShown.label: Title 'Publish road inventory version' / 'Rollback road inventory version'
dataShown.note: States the action.

dataShown.label: 'Target version' tag
dataShown.note: What is being made authoritative.

dataShown.label: 'Dataset ID' #id
dataShown.note: Internal id repeated from the table.

dataShown.label: 'Rows'
dataShown.note: Sanity check that the dataset is not empty.

dataShown.label: 'Current status' (pending/superseded)
dataShown.note: Implied by which button was clicked.

dataShown.label: Consequence paragraph naming the target and the currently published version that will be superseded
dataShown.note: The real confirmation content; wired as aria-describedby.

dataShown.label: Reminder 'After this change, regenerate the mobile road-inventory package if field devices need the new authoritative dataset.'
dataShown.note: Good next-step hint but there is no button to do it from here.

dataShown.label: Busy label 'Applying…'
dataShown.note: Progress cue.

actions.label: Cancel (initial focus)
actions.note: RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:70; data-dialog-initial-focus so Enter does not accidentally confirm

entryPoints: 'Publish' or 'Rollback' button in the versions table (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:196, :207)
exits: Cancel/x/Escape/backdrop; on confirm the dialog closes, the workspace reloads and a notice appears at the top of the page (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:104-110); focus returns to the row button (ModalDialog.tsx:104)

responsive.layout: Centered overlay with a w-full max-w-xl rounded-2xl panel; 2-column dl at sm+.
phoneRisks: Panel is full width minus 32px; dl stacks to one column; total height ~420px fits portrait, may need scroll in landscape but the panel has no overflow-y-auto (ModalDialog.tsx:26).
desktopNotes: 576px centered modal; destructive rollback uses --bad background for the confirm button (:71).

painPoints.issue: Rollback copy degrades when no version is currently published: 'The currently published version will be superseded by the rollback.' with no name.
The dialog tells the admin to regenerate the package next but offers no way to do it; after confirm the user is left at the bottom table while the button is at the top of the page.
'Dataset ID' duplicates an internal id already in the table; 'Current status' restates the button that was clicked.
Inconsistent verb form: title 'Rollback ...', button 'Confirm rollback', notice 'Rolled back' (noun used as verb in UI labels).

strengths: Cancel receives initial focus so Enter cannot accidentally publish/roll back (:70).
Consequence text names both the target and the version being superseded, and rollback is styled destructive (:53-65, :71).
Consequence block is the aria-describedby target of the dialog (:31, :53).
Escape and backdrop dismissal are suppressed while the request is in flight (ModalDialog.tsx:63, :109).

crossCutting: Mobile/tablet navigation: below lg (1024px) AppShell renders the full sidebar as a card above the page content (AppShell.tsx:164), so every admin page starts one screen down on phones and portrait tablets; there is no drawer/hamburger.

Unauthorized redirect target: RoleRoute sends non-admins to /submissions (RoleRoute.tsx:19), a page that deliberately has no nav entry (AppShell.tsx:66-67); HomeRedirect ('/') would be the consistent landing.

Vocabulary drift for the same things: page h1 'User Administration' vs nav 'Users' vs card 'ERIS access management' vs 'Create ERIS account' (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:173, :186, :192; AppShell.tsx:97); h1 'Road Inventory' vs eyebrow 'Authoritative roadway reference' vs h2 'Road inventory operations' (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:121-127); 'Refresh' / 'Refresh state' / 'Refresh history' (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:206, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:131, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:118); 'Not ready' vs 'Not generated' (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:138, :166); 'Segments' vs 'Rows' for row_count (:137, :157 vs :192, RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:48); 'Published' badge plus 'Authoritative' label on the same row (:196); 'Uploaded' vs 'Created' for created_at (:192, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:164).

Raw codes leak into the UI: role enums in the AppShell header ('ADMIN · GEOTECH_ENGINEER', AppShell.tsx:157) and chip titles (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:244); import job 'stage' (RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:152); 17 inventory attribute codes in lookup results (RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:53-54); internal ids everywhere ('User #id' :221, versions '#id' :195, 'Dataset ID' dialog :47, job uuid prefix and dataset_version_id :165, 'Dataset #id' :154).

Three hand-rolled pill badges with the same color-mix class strings but different sizes: AccountStatusBadge (text-xs px-2.5 py-1, AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:12-18), DatasetStatusBadge (text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:30-38), JobBadge (text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:30-40) - one Badge component with a tone prop would replace all three.

Duplicated helpers: formatBytes exists twice with different null handling (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:24-28 vs RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:23-28); formatDate vs formatDateTime (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:17-22, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:10-21); SummaryCard (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:212-214) vs the inline count cards (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:176-182); Field label helper (RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:62-64) vs inline label/span pairs in the other files; the error/notice banner markup is copy-pasted in five places (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:209-210, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:143-144, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:148, RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:47, PasswordResetDialog.tsx:63).

Inconsistent button styles: primary buttons sometimes have hover:brightness-95 (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:187, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:175, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:142, RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:44) and sometimes not (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:199, RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:71); secondary buttons alternate between bare border (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:192, :199, :206) and border + bg + hover (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:130, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:117, dialogs); row buttons use rounded in Users (:224) but rounded-md in Road Inventory (:196); padding alternates px-3/px-4; the dialog close 'x' button is duplicated verbatim in both dialogs (PasswordResetDialog.tsx:50, RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:41).

No <form> elements anywhere in the area: every submit is a type=button onClick, so Enter never submits (create account :193-199, search :204, password reset dialog :53-68, import :122-145, lookup :39-45).

Accessibility gaps: search input and status select without accessible names (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:204-205); no captions on any table; page-level error/notice banners lack role=alert/aria-live (only PasswordResetDialog.tsx:63 has it); overflow-x-auto containers are not keyboard focusable (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:190, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:162, RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:51); role chips hide their checkbox with sr-only and provide no focus-visible style (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:244-245); busy states are text-only with no aria-busy; truncated values rely on hover title attributes (RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:195, :213; RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:165; RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:54); row action buttons ~28px and chips ~24px tall.

Feedback placement: mutation notices render at the top of each page (AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:209-210, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:143-144) while the triggering controls are in tables far below; notices never auto-dismiss and are not announced.

Global busy flags: AdminUsersOperationsPage uses one busy boolean for load/create/save/toggle/reset so every control on the page is disabled during any request (:32, :199, :206, :224); RoadInventoryWorkspacePage is better (loading / packageBusy / versionBusyId, :44-46).

Dead/legacy indirection: web/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx and web/src/pages/RoadInventoryPage.tsx are one-line re-export shims of the feature components (pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx:1, pages/RoadInventoryPage.tsx:1); roleModel.ts carries legacy role aliases (MAINTENANCE, MAINT_COORDINATOR, OFFICE_CHIEF, BRANCH_CHIEF, FIELD_WORKER) that may surface as duplicate chips in the role editor (roleModel.ts:8-13).

No URL state or deep links in the area: user search/filter, selected file, lookup inputs and results all live in component state; there are no /admin/users/:id or /admin/road-inventory/versions/:id routes (App.tsx:143-158).

Strength to keep across the area: consistent use of theme tokens (--line/--panel/--panel-soft/--brand/--good/--bad) and color-mix tints, so all three themes work without page-specific colors; a single accessible ModalDialog primitive (ModalDialog.tsx) is reused by both dialogs; every list has a written empty state.
